required_trace_contract.source_atoms: typed observable atoms with source span digest and deterministic rule id; no raw source copied into persisted ledger
required_trace_contract.canonical_atoms: M31 canonical fields projected into comparable typed atoms
required_trace_contract.verification: each required source atom is supported, contradicted, unavailable, or not_applicable
required_trace_contract.authority: source conflict must be deterministically repaired with explicit provenance or surface authority revoked
required_trace_contract.direct_japanese: self-contained Japanese literal source uses identity/normalization rather than mandatory translation inference

claim_boundary: author-constructed source-disjoint controlled reserve; transparent slot and atom proxy; not independently authored, professionally translated, open-domain, human-rated, or proof of human-like understanding
post_result_rule: do_not_modify_m33_from_m33_reserve_outcomes; failures move to a new milestone and a new reserve
